title: The Library of Alexandria
audience: General viewers who want an accurate short explanation.

chapters.title: A city of learning
chapters.objective: Place the library inside the Ptolemaic institution that produced it.

chapters.title: Change instead of one catastrophe
chapters.objective: Replace the single-fire story with the gradual change historians describe.

chapters.title: What lasted
chapters.objective: State the idea that outlived the building.

chapters.title: Explanatory scene forms
chapters.objective: Demonstrate the reusable knowledge-video scene types on the same subject.

scenes.title: The Library of Alexandria
scenes.objective: Open on the subject and the ambition it stands for.
scenes.visualDirection: Title card over a restrained archival palette.

scenes.title: A new city of learning
scenes.objective: Locate the institution in Ptolemaic Alexandria.
scenes.visualDirection: Supplied illustration of the harbour city with a slow push in.

scenes.title: An institution changed over centuries
scenes.objective: Show that creation, change, and loss were not one moment.
scenes.visualDirection: Three staged timeline entries revealed in order.

scenes.title: The famous fire is not the whole story
scenes.objective: Separate the popular image from the historical reading.
scenes.visualDirection: Split comparison between the popular story and the cautious reading.

scenes.title: What lasted
scenes.objective: Close on the idea that collected knowledge can outlast a generation.

scenes.title: Texts moved across the Mediterranean
scenes.objective: Show movement of texts as a drawn route.
scenes.visualDirection: Schematic map with an animated route.

scenes.title: Illustrative collection growth
scenes.visualDirection: Bar chart that grows with the narration.

scenes.title: Scale
scenes.objective: Hold one number long enough to register.
scenes.visualDirection: Single large statistic with a caption.

scenes.title: Historical caution
scenes.objective: Show the wording of a cautious historical claim.

scenes.title: A network of patronage and scholarship
scenes.visualDirection: Relationship diagram drawn during the line.

scenes.title: One city, many forms of knowledge
scenes.objective: Cover breadth without dwelling on any single image.

scenes.title: Generated and sourced clips can coexist
scenes.objective: Prove hybrid playback inside the image-led edit.
scenes.visualDirection: Selected candidate clip, muted, cut into the image sequence.

scenes.title: A scholar enters the story
scenes.objective: Introduce a person with a controlled reveal.

scenes.title: Focus moves with the explanation
scenes.objective: Move attention through depth rather than cutting.
scenes.visualDirection: Layered 2.5D parallax with a focus change.
